## Every Plan Includes

#### Enterprise Security

SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliant. Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

#### 250+ Integrations

Connect with your existing tools including HRIS, QuickBooks, and major platforms.

#### Real Human Support

Talk to actual humans when you need help. No bots, no tickets lost in the void.

#### Mobile Apps

Native iOS and Android apps. Update compliance status from anywhere.

## Frequently Asked Questions

###### Can I switch plans at any time?

Absolutely! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan whenever you want. Changes take effect immediately, and we'll prorate any billing adjustments.

###### Is there a free trial?

Yes! Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start. You'll have full access to all features during the trial period.

###### What happens to my data if I cancel?

Your data remains available for 30 days after cancellation. You can export everything at any time. We believe your data belongs to you.

###### Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or education?

Yes, we offer 10% off for verified nonprofit organizations and educational institutions. Contact our sales team to learn more.
